title: SensorObservation
description: Anonymous, numerical-only crowd observation emitted by a CrowdPulse smartphone sensor node. Contains no images, no identifiers of individuals, no biometrics.

sensor_id.description: Anonymous node identifier (random, not tied to a person or device serial).

device_motion_stability.description: 1.0 = perfectly still; low values mean the device is being moved.

person_count.description: Number of anonymous person detections in the current frame window.

estimated_density.description: Relative density index 0..1 (NOT persons per square metre).

mode.description: Optional: how the observation was produced.

zone_hint.description: Optional operator-chosen zone (id or name). Used when the GPS position is not within a zone; GPS wins inside the district.
